welcome.text: Choose a book to make, read, or look through. To make a book, type a word to choose what happens next. Your picture will appear and I will read the page.

choose.text: What happens next? Type one of the words. Press space or enter to see your picture and hear the next page.

choose-1.text: What can the cat do? Type hop or nap. Then press space or enter.

choose-2.text: Where does the cat go? Type moon or star. Then press space or enter.

choose-3.text: What colour is the bed? Type red or blue. Then press space or enter.

copy.text: Copy the words above. Each letter has a sound. Press the space bar to hear your word. Tap the arrow when you have finished.

finished.text: You made your own book! Tap the speaker to hear it, or turn the pages.

help.text: Type one of the words above. Look at the glowing letter. You can use backspace to change a letter.

conflict.text: Your book has newer saved words. Your typing is safe here too. Ask a grown-up to help you choose which words to keep.

choose-luciana-0.text: What did Luciana sit on? Type mat or hat. Then press space or enter.

choose-luciana-1.text: What did Luciana pat? Type cat or rat. Then press space or enter.

choose-luciana-2.text: What did Luciana run to? Type drink or sock. Then press space or enter.

choose-luciana-3.text: How did Luciana feel? Type sad or mad. Then press space or enter.

bd-come-choose-1.text: What can the cat do? Type sit or run. Then press space or enter.

bd-come-choose-2.text: What does the cat have? Type sock or snail. Then press space or enter.

bd-come-choose-3.text: What can the cat do next? Type nap or play. Then press space or enter.

bd-where-choose-1.text: What can you see? Type cat or car. Then press space or enter.

bd-where-choose-2.text: What can you see now? Type bug or dad. Then press space or enter.

bd-where-choose-3.text: What happens next? Type run or sit. Then press space or enter.

read-finished.text: You finished your book. You can turn the pages or hear it again.

picture-finished.text: You looked through your book. You can turn the pages and tell your own story.

page-moon.text: the cat is on the moon.

page-star.text: the cat is on a star.

page-red-bed.text: the cat has a red bed.

page-blue-bed.text: the cat has a blue bed.

page-bd-come-read-01.text: Come back, cat! Play with me.

page-bd-come-read-02.text: Sit in your basket. Stay right here!

page-bd-come-read-03.text: Come back, cat! That’s way too high.

page-bd-come-read-04.text: Come back, cat! Don’t go outside.

page-bd-come-read-06.text: Come back, cat! That’s not yours.

page-bd-come-read-07.text: Come back, cat! What have you got?

page-bd-come-read-08.text: Come back, cat. That’s not your friend!

page-bd-come-read-10.text: Stay in your basket. It’s nap time now.
